description: This file contains shell script functions related to managing firmware upgrades for Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions to determine the target firmware partition, switch boot partitions, and perform the upgrade process based on firmware images.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition (kernel1/kernel2) based on current boot environment and UBI partition status.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process for Linksys devices, selecting the correct partition based on magic number and handling the upgrade accordingly.
